feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Trump names national intelligence chief Jay Clayton as new AI czar
entry.summary: Trump said Clayton will lead the White House's new "Super Intelligence Force," which will coordinate government engagement with artificial intelligence.

entry.title: Cornell president calls gang rape allegations 'deeply disturbing'
entry.summary: Cornell president Michael I. Kotlikoff said his university "must do better" in a video statement. "This is a defining moment in Cornell's history," he added.

entry.title: U.S. Marine arrested for alleged murder of a woman in Okinawa, Japan
entry.summary: Japanese police arrested a U.S. Marine in the alleged robbery and murder of a woman on Okinawa, officials said Sunday.

entry.title: How the Cornell case is affecting women who have experienced sexual assault
entry.summary: The rape allegations that have emerged from a Cornell University frat house are leading many women to remember their own experiences — and call for a wider reckoning over sexual violence.

entry.title: She died covering war for Fox News. Her parents blame the network — and a star reporter
entry.summary: The family members of two Fox News journalists killed while covering the war in Ukraine are suing the network, saying it put getting the story ahead of its people.

entry.title: Latter-day Saints women turn away from scandal-plagued Republican candidate in Arizona
entry.summary: Arizona Republican candidate for Congress Mark Lamb has been accused of sexual misconduct while sheriff. His controversy is turning many voters away as Democrats see an opportunity in the red seat.

entry.title: Coast Guard finds debris from medical plane carrying 6 people
entry.summary: Flight data shows the jet dropped at least 9,000 feet over two minutes, then leveled off for several more minutes, before disappearing.

entry.title: The record-breaking, genre-melting, career-redefining evolution of Miranda Lambert
entry.summary: Lambert started out as a scrappy country singer with a me-against-the-world attitude. How did she end up making lush disco songs and writing one of the biggest pop hits of the year?

entry.title: All's fair in love and 'War' — a well-cast, classy-trashy divorce drama
entry.summary: HBO's War is intended to be an anthology series about two dueling London law firms. The first season stars Dominic West and Sienna Miller as a high-profile couple in the midst of a very nasty divorce.

entry.title: Just short of its 200th birthday, a landmark natural history museum shuts down
entry.summary: Beloved for its dinosaurs, Philadelphia's storied Academy of Natural Sciences closed down this week, amid an intense fight by local residents, politicians and scientists to save it.
